veranderings.rede: The block is about inventors, and 'gemaak' (made) is vaguer than 'uitgevind', which the next sentences use.
Televisie is one word, so saying it 'sounds like' one word is illogical; the point is that it looks like a single word but has two parts.
In Afrikaans the prepositional phrase normally comes before the predicate adjective: 'nie vir kinders geskik nie'.

veranderings.voor: uit te stuur, en nie na gekose mense nie
veranderings.na: uit te stuur en nie na gekose mense nie
veranderings.rede: AWS: no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence; the clause has no own subject and verb, and the kleurtelevisie entry already writes the same pattern without one.
